impacts.description: Improved employability and career prospects of MSCA postdoctoral fellows within academia and beyond, resulting from increased research and transferable skills and competences.

impacts.description: New mind-sets and approaches to R&I work developed through international, inter-sectoral and interdisciplinary mobility, advancing research culture and cross-boundary scientific practice.
impacts.source_section: Expected Outcome – For supported postdoctoral fellows

impacts.description: Increased and broadened research and innovation impact through enhanced networking and communication capacities of fellows with scientific peers and the general public.

impacts.description: Increased alignment of researcher working conditions with the principles of the European Charter for Researchers across participating organisations, strengthening research policy implementation.
Enhanced quality and long-term sustainability of research training and supervision practices at participating organisations.
Increased global attractiveness, visibility and reputation of European and associated research organisations, contributing to the European Research Area.
Stronger R&I capacity and output among participating organisations and better transfer of knowledge across sectors.
Regular feedback of research results into teaching and education at participating organisations, strengthening the research–education nexus.
